items.headline: Value Creed launches RADAR data intelligence tool
items.summary: Value Creed introduced RADAR, a tool aimed at turning the vast data commodity traders generate into actionable intelligence, according to CTRM Center coverage of the vendor's latest release.

items.headline: BRAC Bank goes live on Finastra trade finance stack
items.summary: Bangladesh's BRAC Bank completed a go-live on Finastra's Trade Innovation and Corporate Channels platform, also deploying Conpend's Trade AI orchestration tool to digitise trade finance operations.

items.headline: LA/Long Beach strike risk threatens import flows
items.summary: A possible watchmen strike at Los Angeles and Long Beach ports could halt terminal operations handling most of the complex's cargo, with no labor deal announced as of October 30, per a logistics industry weekly freight report.

items.headline: EACH responds to REMIT-EMIR reporting guideline
items.summary: The European clearinghouse association EACH submitted feedback on ACER's draft guideline aligning REMIT and EMIR transaction reporting, supporting the goal of reducing duplicative compliance burdens while flagging areas needing clarification for CCPs.
